controls.label: weight w3
controls.help: Third weight; when n is at least 3 it alters T and therefore all active probabilities, contributions and H.

controls.label: weight w4

controls.label: active outcome count n

visuals.title: Bit contributions c_i of each active outcome

explorations.title: Certainty: one weight carries everything
explorations.instruction: weights w1 = 4, w2 = 0, w3 = 0, w4 = 0 with active outcome count n = 4
explorations.observe: total is 4, the active probability vector is (1, 0, 0, 0), the contributions are (0, 0, 0, 0) bits and entropy H is 0 bits.
explorations.why: Normalization puts all probability on outcome 1, and a zero probability contributes its limiting value 0, so every term of the sum vanishes.

explorations.title: Equal likelihood at the largest active count
explorations.instruction: weights w1 = 1, w2 = 1, w3 = 1, w4 = 1 with active outcome count n = 4
explorations.observe: total is 4, the active probability vector is (0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25), each contribution is 0.5 bits and entropy H is 2 bits.
explorations.why: Four equal weights normalize to p_i = 1/4, and each term -p_i log2 p_i equals 0.5 bits, so the sum is log2 4 = 2 bits.
